# mgc_network_vpcs_peerings (Data Source)

Network VPC Peerings

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All peerings of the current tenant.
data "mgc_network_vpcs_peerings" "all" {}

# Only the peerings a given VPC takes part in.
data "mgc_network_vpcs_peerings" "by_vpc" {
  vpc_id = "your-vpc-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `vpc_id` (String) When set, only the peerings this VPC takes part in are returned.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of VPC peerings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `accepter_vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC that received the peering invitation.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of the peering creation.
- `description` (String) The description to help identify the peering.
- `id` (String) The ID of the peering.
- `name` (String) The name of the peering.
- `requester_vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC that requested the peering.
- `status` (String) Current status of the peering.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the last peering update.
